title: retail-layout-simulator: agent-based retail-layout simulation and optimization
description: An agent-based customer-flow simulator for 2D retail floor plans, calibrated against public transactional, in-store and pedestrian-trajectory datasets, with Monte Carlo, Markov-chain and genetic-algorithm engines for evaluating and optimizing item placement. It ships the headless, seeded experiment runners, tests and per-run artifacts behind every reported number, so the results can be regenerated from the code.
